essence: The practitioner becomes fearless through a month of worship with specified substances.
Fearlessness is attained by practicing in a lonely forest at night for a month.
The rite employs these flowers and honey in a prescribed sequence.
The practitioner may worship in any of these secluded or sacred places.
The practitioner salutes and then worships the very black goddess in the black circle.
